1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Nf6 3.d4 Bg4 4.f3 Bf5 5.B.strategy: Secures the d5 pawn with a pawn, so Black cannot win it back easily while the knight on d7 is pinned. White holds the extra pawn and a space advantage, but the position is loose around the king, and Black plays for a central pawn break to open the game.
1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Nf6 3.d4 Bg4 4.f3 Bf5 5.B.name: Scandinavian Defence: Portuguese Gambit, Jadoul Variation

1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Nf6 3.d4 Bg4 4.f3 Bf5 5.B.strategy: Defends d5 with a piece and develops, but the knight blocks the c-pawn, so no pawn supports d5. It holds the pawn less firmly than a pawn would and gives Black targets for piece play, while White keeps the extra pawn.
1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Nf6 3.d4 Bg4 4.f3 Bf5 5.B.name: Scandinavian Defence: Portuguese Gambit, Melbourne Shuffle Variation
